# Timeline (`timeline`)

Activity feed and journey milestones.

Group: Data display. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/data-display';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

`createTimeline` (types in `dist/web/data-display/timeline.d.ts`): `ol.mh-timeline`: entries in time order. `--list` puts the time in a column with tabular figures (departures, reminders, events); `--feed` threads a vertical line through a `__marker` per entry (a dot, or an icon with `__item--icon`) with the time as a small line above the title (activity, milestones). Each `li.__item` holds a `__row` (`div`, or a `button` with `onSelect`) with `__marker` (feed), `__time` and `__body` (`__title`, `__detail`). Tones: `__item--accent | --success | --warning | --danger`.

```ts
export function createTimeline(options: TimelineOptions): TimelineHandle;

export interface TimelineOptions {
  items: TimelineItem[];
  variant?: TimelineVariant;
  /** Accessible name of the list ("Departures", "Recent activity"). */
  label?: string;
  /** Makes every row a button; called with the row's index. */
  onSelect?: (index: number) => void;
}

export interface TimelineHandle {
  el: HTMLOListElement;
  setItems(items: TimelineItem[]): void;
}

export interface TimelineItem {
  /** Shown as written ("07:42", "In 5 min", "Yesterday"). */
  time: string;
  title: string;
  detail?: string | null;
  /** Colours the time (`list`) or the marker (`feed`). Default `neutral`. */
  tone?: TimelineTone;
  /** The marker icon in the `feed` variant (default: a dot). Not shown in `list`. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createText, createTimeline, type TimelineItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const departures: TimelineItem[] = [
  { time: '07:42', title: 'Line 4 to Harbour Square', detail: 'Platform 2' },
  { time: '07:51', title: 'Line 11 to North Park', detail: '3 min late', tone: 'warning' },
  { time: '08:05', title: 'Line 4 to Harbour Square', detail: 'Cancelled', tone: 'danger' },
  { time: '08:12', title: 'Express to the airport', detail: 'On time', tone: 'success' },
];

const selected = createText('Press a departure', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const timeline = createTimeline({
  label: 'Departures',
  items: departures,
  onSelect: (i) => (selected.textContent = `Selected: ${departures[i]!.time} ${departures[i]!.title}`),
});

document.body.append(timeline.el, selected);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Text, Timeline } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { TimelineItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const departures: TimelineItem[] = [
  { time: '07:42', title: 'Line 4 to Harbour Square', detail: 'Platform 2' },
  { time: '07:51', title: 'Line 11 to North Park', detail: '3 min late', tone: 'warning' },
  { time: '08:05', title: 'Line 4 to Harbour Square', detail: 'Cancelled', tone: 'danger' },
  { time: '08:12', title: 'Express to the airport', detail: 'On time', tone: 'success' },
];

export function TimelineExample() {
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const departure = picked === null ? null : departures[picked];
  return (
    <>
      <Timeline label="Departures" items={departures} onSelect={setPicked} />
      <Text variant="caption" tone="muted">
        {departure ? `Selected: ${departure.time} ${departure.title}` : 'Press a departure'}
      </Text>
    </>
  );
}
```
